div.div:
REPLAY — make replay FROM= TO= runs archive files back through the same Pipeline class as the consumer (no second implementation), deduplicated on (topic, partition, offset).
make replay-dlq decodes dead letters with the current parser and injects the repaired ones back into the source topic.

text.tspan: REPLAY — make replay FROM= TO= runs archive files back through the same Pipeline class as the consumer (no second implementation), deduplicated on (topic, partition, offset).
make replay-dlq decodes dead letters with the current parser and injects the repaired ones back into the source topic.
